problem: Small businesses often pay for software while still doing repetitive work manually.
target_viewer: small-business owner, freelancer, entrepreneur, ambitious worker
hypothesis: A carefully selected AI workflow can reduce the time required for one repetitive business task without creating unacceptable manual cleanup.

baseline.measurement: Time required to complete the task manually

intervention.measurement: Time required plus human cleanup time and direct tool cost

procedure: Run the same task through the selected AI/software workflow.
Record elapsed time and direct cost.
Record errors, corrections, and human intervention.
stopping_conditions: The experiment cannot produce a reproducible baseline.
The intervention requires sensitive personal data.
Direct cost exceeds the predetermined test budget.
